_note: Style presets (docs/song-builder-prd.md B11; DECISIONS.md: Skate punk and 2000s pop-punk (Emo removed by the owner, 2026-10-04); eras and techniques, never artists). A preset is a starting point, not a lock: it sets the feel, sometimes the progression, the length, and each unlocked section's Options. `grooves` lists the grooves it prefers per section, best first: the first one that can play in the song's key, tempo and difficulty is used. `options` adds playing style, shapes or structure. Locked sections are never touched. npm run verify checks every name here exists.

skate.label: Skate punk
skate.description: Fast and tight: palm-muted gallops, driving choruses, a short song that stops on a hit.

poppunk.label: 2000s pop-punk
poppunk.description: Big and bright: an octave hook, offbeat verses, 3-note choruses with pushes, and the last chorus up a tone.
